all_roots_split.label: all roots split
all_roots_split.meaning: Old aggressive policy; every source-level E11 root becomes an episode.

collapse_all_undated.label: collapse all undated
collapse_all_undated.meaning: Split fully dated roots; collapse every root set containing an undated root.

dated_only.label: dated only
dated_only.meaning: Split roots only when every root has a supplied date boundary.

source_semantics.label: source semantics
source_semantics.meaning: Split fully dated roots and configured source-semantic sequences; collapse unsupported undated roots.

queries.current_condition_to_treatment: Which condition states are associated through treated components with current-local modifications?
queries.current_modification_retrieval: Which E11 modifications are local to the current identity?
queries.current_technique_over_time: Which treatment techniques occur in current-local modifications, with supplied episode order/date?
queries.current_treatment_history: Which top-level treatment episodes are local to the current identity?
queries.current_treatment_material_over_time: Which treatment materials occur in current-local modifications, with supplied episode order/date?
queries.lineage_condition_to_treatment: Which condition states are associated through treated components with lineage-wide modifications?
queries.lineage_modification_retrieval: Which E11 modifications occur anywhere in the current identity's lineage?
queries.lineage_technique_over_time: Which treatment techniques occur over the full treatment lineage?
queries.lineage_treatment_history: Which top-level treatment episodes occur anywhere in the current identity's lineage?
queries.lineage_treatment_material_over_time: Which treatment materials occur over the full treatment lineage?

segmentation: Segmented profile creates one resulting identity per supplied top-level E11 treatment episode. Nested E11 hierarchy is preserved.
